text.en:
1. These Regulations may be cited as the Election Commission citation.
(Amendment of Schedule) Regulations 1992.

2. (1) The Schedule to the Election Commission Act 1957 is amended First

by substituting for paragraph 1 the following paragraph:                een
"1, SALARY:
Chairman                              $ 4665.60 per month
Deputy Chairman                    $ 4017.60 per month

FIXED ALLOWANCE:
Members                            $ 3402.00 per month

P.U. (A) 79.                             368

ACTING ALLOWANCE:

In the event of the Deputy Chairman or any member
performing the functions of the Chairman or Deputy
Chairman during a period exceeding twenty eight days, he
shall be entitled to an acting allowance, equivalent to the
difference between his salary or fixed allowance, as the
case may be, and the salary of the position he is acting in.".

(2) Subregulation (1) shall be deemed to have come into force on
the Ist January 1989.

Second      3. (1) The Schedule to the Election Commission Act 1957, as
Amdan      amended in regulation 2, is amended—

(a) by substituting for paragraph 1 the following paragraph:

"1. SALARY:
Chairman                       $ 6310 per month
Deputy Chairman           $ 4700 per month
FIXED ALLOWANCE:
Members                       $ 3950 per month
ACTING ALLOWANCE:

In the event of the Deputy Chairman or any
member performing the functions of the Chairman
or Deputy Chairman during a period exceeding
twenty eight days, he shall be entitled to an acting
allowance, equivalent to the difference between
his salary or fixed allowance, as the case may be,
and the salary of the position he is acting in.".

(b) by substituting for paragraph 12 the following paragraph:
"12. MONTHLY ENTERTAINMENT

ALLOWANCE:

Chairman                 $ 1,500
Deputy Chairman    $ 800
Members       $ 550".

(2) Subparagraph (1) shall be deemed to have come into force on
the Ist January 1992,

Made the 14th February 1992,
(PM, (R) 10197 Jld, VII; PN. (PU?) 373.1

By Command,

TAN Sri Dato' Seri AHMAD SARJI BIN ABDUL HAMID,
Secretary to the Cabinet
